narrative: Maccabi Bnei Reineh host Kiryat Shmona at Green Stadium with their entire (already remote) survival hope on the line — bottom of the relegation playoff group on 11 points with -40 goal difference, they need to win all three remaining fixtures and hope for help. Kiryat Shmona are mathematically safe in 10th and travel without urgency, missing key attackers Shaheen, Cohen, Dadia plus a doubtful Bangoura. Home form has been poor, but the Damascan-Shaker axis has powered back-to-back wins at Haifa and Sakhnin and the do-or-die mood should tilt early possession to Reineh. Sim favors a narrow home win.
